description: 情報通信業基本調査(2021年) [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Data Catalog Site of the Japanese government (data.go.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 総務省. 情報通信業に属する企業の実態を明らかにし、情報通信政策の基礎資料を得る。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 総務省. Its tags are 統計, 統計調査結果. It offers 7 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2023-06-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-datago-portal.
